question: What analogy explains why the bodies of the upper and lower Rudras are not seen separately?
premises: Because of a predominant fiery nature, earth atoms in gold do not appear separately.
The same applies to what is present in the bodies of the upper and lower Rudras.
inference: The Rudra bodies are not perceived separately, just as earth atoms are not seen separately in gold.
plain_english: Just as earth atoms do not appear separately in gold because of gold's predominant fiery nature, so too what is present in the bodies of the upper and lower Rudras does not appear separately.
